entries.title: Major Performance Update
entries.contents:
This release brings significant performance improvements across the board:

  • Reduced memory usage by 30%
  • Fixed lag spikes in busy areas
  • Improved startup time

entries.title: New Visual Enhancements
entries.contents:
Added several visual improvements to the modpack:

  • Enhanced water reflections
  • Better lighting in caves and dungeons
  • New particle effects for spells

entries.title: Quest Tracker Improvements
entries.contents:
Updates to the quest tracking system:

  • Fixed quest markers sometimes not appearing
  • Added ability to filter quests by type
  • Improved quest list organization

entries.title: Bug Fixes
entries.contents:
Several important bug fixes:

  • Fixed crash when entering certain dungeons
  • Resolved incompatibility with latest game update
  • Fixed minimap issues in new zones

entries.title: Initial Release
entries.contents:
First public release of the Wynncraft Overhaul modpack installer! Features include:

  • Easy one-click installation
  • Support for multiple launchers
  • Customizable mod selection
